title: Sweep mixture proportions and value correlations
frozenHypothesis: Composition-corrected aggregation magnitude and sorting kinetics depend on exact policy composition and policy-value association.

threeWayProfiles.rule: 34/33/33 with the single extra identity rotating by replicateOrdinal modulo 3

scenarioGeneration.valueConstruction: Reuse valuesById and initialOccupancyIndices from each immutable E01 exploratory base draw; every condition sharing inputProfile and replicateOrdinal has the same values, initial value sequence, and pairingBlockId.

policyOrder.pairwise: the policy tuple order printed in policyPairs

scenarioGeneration.positiveRule: Sort identities by increasing value with deterministic random tie-breaking, then assign contiguous exact-count blocks in policy order.
scenarioGeneration.negativeRule: Sort identities by decreasing value with the same deterministic tie-breaking, then assign contiguous exact-count blocks in policy order.
scenarioGeneration.absentRule: Uniformly permute identities independently of value, then assign contiguous exact-count blocks in policy order.
scenarioGeneration.associationMetric: Spearman correlation between midrank(value) and midrank(policy ordinal); eta-squared of value by policy is an order-invariant strength sensitivity.
scenarioGeneration.runtimePairingBoundary: Initial values and occupancy are paired. Runtime seeds share a base address, but the validated simulator also keys streams by content-derived scenarioId; transition randomness is therefore reproducible but not asserted identical across conditions.

metrics.compositionCorrection: sum_k n_k(n_k-1)/n^2 for the publication /n score
metrics.minorityHomotypy: same-minority linear edges divided by minority count; exact random expectation (n_minority-1)/n and lattice resolution 1/n_minority
metrics.peakBoundary: Peak metrics are descriptive secondary outcomes and are not dynamic-null or maximum-selection corrected.

composition.contrasts: first-policy count 10 vs 50 and 90 vs 50, separately by input profile and policy pair
composition.interval: paired 10000-draw bootstrap with Bonferroni 95% family coverage; individual confidence level 0.9958333333333333

correlation.contrasts: positive vs absent and negative vs absent, separately by input profile and policy set
correlation.interval: paired 10000-draw bootstrap with Bonferroni 95% family coverage; individual confidence level 0.996875

secondaryUncertainty.meanTrajectoryBands: pointwise 95% t intervals; not simultaneous and not peak intervals
secondaryUncertainty.varianceAnalysis: SD, IQR, unique lattice values, and paired-bootstrap extreme-to-balanced variance ratios

successCriteria.execution: All 46500 intended runs are accounted for; exact counts, pairing, association direction, value conservation, baseline identities, and artifacts validate; no protected row is read.
successCriteria.compositionMagnitude: At least one predeclared composition contrast has an adjusted interval excluding zero and absolute corrected-AUC difference at least 0.03.
successCriteria.correlationMagnitude: At least one predeclared correlation contrast has an adjusted interval excluding zero and absolute corrected-final difference at least 0.05.
successCriteria.kinetics: At least one predeclared composition or correlation contrast has an adjusted interval excluding zero and absolute accepted-swap difference at least 5% of its reference-condition mean.
successCriteria.supportive: Execution plus all three scientific criteria pass.
successCriteria.null: Execution passes but no usable composition/correlation signal meets the frozen practical criteria.
successCriteria.constrainingContradictory: Execution passes but only a subset of the magnitude/kinetic hypothesis is supported, association control fails, or extreme discreteness materially limits the claimed scope.

validation.association: Every positive run has rho > 0; every negative run has rho < 0; each absent condition has absolute mean rho <= 0.03 and at least 90% of absent-condition 95% mean intervals contain zero.
validation.counts: Every observed policy count equals its condition/replicate rule and sums to 100.
validation.pairing: Each of 500 input-profile/replicate blocks contains exactly 93 conditions with one immutable value/occupancy hash.
validation.replay: 18 preregistered scenarios spanning both inputs, all correlations, and extreme/balanced pairwise or rare three-way classes replay exactly.
validation.upstreamImmutability: S01 and S02 manifests and every listed artifact retain their recorded hashes.
validation.artifactChecks: Schemas, row accounting, correction identities, interval ordering, figure presence, source commit, and manifest hashes all pass.

claimBoundaries: S03 estimates associations within the deterministic clean-room simulator, not biological effects.
The policy ordinal is a construction device; eta-squared is retained because policy is otherwise nominal.
Static composition correction does not replace the S05 static null distributions or S06 dynamic peak correction.
S03 does not measure alternative clustering metrics assigned to S04 and must stop before S04.
